name: api
description: Must have ```credentials [test] aws_access_key_id = fake aws_secret_access_key = fake aws_session_token = fake region = us-east-1 ```  in .aws/credentials for development

scripts.build: esbuild server.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm "--banner:js=delete process.env.AWS_PROFILE; import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js --alias:api=.
